title: Ice cream cone, scooped, chocolate, waffle cone

content.title: About
content.content: A scoop of chocolate ice cream served in a crisp waffle cone. The ice cream is made from milk, cream, sugar and cocoa, while the cone is baked from wheat flour, sugar and vegetable oil until golden and crunchy.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Waffle cones originated in Italy in the early 1920s and quickly spread worldwide.
Chocolate ice cream often contains a small amount of cocoa butter, giving it a smoother texture.
The standard scoop size is about 50 g, providing a balanced portion.
Waffle cones can be slightly sweet or lightly salty, enhancing the contrast with chocolate.
Ice cream cones are frequently topped with sprinkles, nuts, or fruit sauces.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Dairy ingredients supply calcium, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Contains vitamin D
items.content: Vitamin D in dairy helps the body absorb calcium more efficiently.

items.title: Quick energy
items.content: Sugar and fat provide rapid energy, making it a refreshing treat on hot days.

items.title: Antioxidants from cocoa
items.content: Chocolate contributes flavonoids, which have mild antioxidant properties.

items.title: Mood boost
items.content: Sweet desserts stimulate serotonin production, improving mood.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Large amounts of sugar can contribute to weight gain and raise blood glucose levels.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience digestive discomfort.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: An allergy to milk or whey requires complete avoidance of the product.

items.title: Nut and gluten cross‑contamination
items.content: Waffle cones may contain traces of nuts and gluten, important for those with allergies.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: One cone with a scoop can contain 250–350 kcal, so portion control is advised.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve immediately after preparation to keep the cone crunchy. Add sprinkles, nuts, caramel sauce, or fresh berries for extra flavor variety.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the ice cream in a freezer at –18 °C or lower. Store the waffle cone in a dry place to prevent it from becoming soft. Do not leave the ice cream at room temperature for more than 30 minutes.
